title: Columbus retail jobs: store managers, customer service, bilingual support, and stockroom roles
text:
21 hours ago Columbus retail openings in this group range from store leadership to customer-facing and back-of-house support. Journeys and Spencer Gifts - Spirit Halloween are both hiring assistant store managers in full-time roles, while Marshalls is seeking a part-time Customer Experience Coordinator focused on front-end service. Stefanini’s bilingual Spanish customer service role is centered on customer support and order handling in a supply-center setting, and Duluth Trading Company’s Seasonal Retail Support Associate focuses on stockroom and freight work tied to store operations.
